general_issues: Select lbowling.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 4 computers. Each computer runs a separate cabinet. Wait for automatic service-menu setup and reboot, then select MULTI-LINK PLAY. Two local players per cabinet.
